# Learned instinct: gitlab-protected-variables-for-secrets (confidence 1)

CI/CD variables containing credentials, tokens, or keys must be marked both `Protected` (only available on protected branches/tags) and `Masked` (hidden from job logs). Unprotected secrets variables are visible to any branch pipeline, which violates PCI Req 8.3. Prefer Vault lookups over CI variables for secrets; use CI variables only as a fallback.

Source: PCI DSS v4.0.1 Req 8.3.x; GitLab CI variable protection docs
